reported.title: Heartbeat blocked during chime pulse
reported.description: pulseChimeBlocking() calls delay(CHIME_MS) at line 27, which stalls the whole loop for 1800 ms, so the heartbeat check at lines 57-62 cannot run while the chime sounds. Measured gaps of 1800 ms between `gate-hb` lines (e.g. 2009.189 to 3809.274) confirm the heartbeat is suspended for the full pulse duration instead of every 300 ms. Expected /^gate-hb$/ every 300 ± 100 ms; 6 of 9 intervals were out of tolerance, worst gap 1800 ms.

reported.title: Firmware silent for 1800 ms during chime
reported.description: The blocking delay(CHIME_MS) at line 27 holds the CPU with no serial output and no pin change for the entire pulse, and loop() re-enters pulseChimeBlocking() immediately while the gate stays open (lines 52-55). Measured silence of 1800 ms (e.g. 200.008 to 2000.019) exceeds the 700 ms limit, and back-to-back pulses chain these silent gaps. Firmware went silent for 1800 ms with no serial output or pin activity (limit 700 ms); 6 such gap(s).

exposing_checks.behaviour: serial lines matching '^gate-hb$' every 300 ms (Gate heartbeat)
responds to stimulus within None ms (Stay responsive)

judge_input.spec:
- Porch gate contact on D3 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW when open); chime driver on D10.
- A settled open event as short as 40 ms starts an 1800 ms HIGH pulse on D10 within 150 ms.
- Presses while the chime is already sounding are ignored (pulse length is not restarted).
- Print the exact line `gate-hb` every 300 ms continuously, including while the chime is sounding.
- Never remain silent (no serial and no output change) for more than 700 ms.
- Closed/idle gate reads HIGH on D3.

exposing_checks.behaviour: serial lines matching '^gate-hb$' every 300 ms (Gate heartbeat)
responds to stimulus within None ms (Stay responsive)
